questions.question: If you miss your exit on a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Make a quick turn from your lane.
Keep driving until you reach the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you reach the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, do not back up. Instead, go to the next exit or safe place to turn around. It is illegal to back up on a freeway shoulder.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, what must you do?

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are near.
Signal only if other cars are visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are near.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from the curb. Make signaling a habit so you never forget to do it.

questions.question: Mixing drugs and alcohol while driving:

options.text: Increases your chance of having a crash.
Is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
Makes alcohol less harmful to your driving.
Does not affect your driving ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases your chance of having a crash.
questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, and over-the-counter) can harm your brain function and make driving unsafe. Mixing alcohol with drugs greatly increases your crash risk.

questions.question: When driving on wet roads, remember:

options.text: Roads are slippery right when rain starts.
You need more space to stop.

questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous, especially when rain first starts. Your car travels on a thin layer of oil, dirt, and water. Slow down in heavy rain or standing water to keep your tires from slipping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up on the road.

questions.question: A steady green light means you:

options.text: Must slow down and be ready to stop.
Must stop and check for other traffic before going.
May drive through if the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: May drive through if the intersection is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light lets you drive through the intersection if it is clear. You can also turn right or left unless a sign says you cannot. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians when turning.

questions.question: A stop sign has what shape?
questions.explanation: Only stop signs use an octagon shape. This eight-sided sign tells drivers to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Seat belts work best when worn by:

options.text: Everyone in the car every time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Everyone in the car every time.
questions.explanation: Make sure every person in your vehicle wears a seat belt every time you drive. In a crash, a person without a seat belt becomes a flying object and can hurt others in the car.

questions.question: You see a driver ahead steering with one hand while talking to a passenger. You should:

options.text: Keep extra space between you and that vehicle.
Know that driver is not paying full attention.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted by passengers, looking for things, reading, sightseeing, or daydreaming while driving. If another driver seems distracted, give them extra space because they are more likely to crash.

questions.question: Which driver is inattentive?

options.text: One who stares off the road or daydreams while driving.
One who looks at a passenger instead of the road.
One who only watches the car ahead.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted by passengers, looking for things, reading, sightseeing, or daydreaming. Keep scanning the road, checking mirrors, and looking at your dashboard. These safe habits help you stay attentive while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle, you must:

options.text: Slow down until it passes you.
Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Motion for the emergency vehicle to pass you.
Merge into the right lane and continue driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: Give the right-of-way to any emergency vehicle with flashing lights or a siren. Move to the right side of the road and stop until it passes. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then stop on the right side.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that makes you take your attention away from driving, take your eyes off the road, or take your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, along with fog lights if your vehicle has them. High beams bounce off fog and reflect back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: A driver must practice driving on a probationary license for up to:
questions.explanation: You must drive without supervision for at least one year on a probationary license before getting a basic driver license. Follow all rules for probationary license holders during this time.

questions.question: You are in an accident. You should:
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle right away. Move it out of traffic if possible. Call the police and ask for an ambulance if needed. Do not move injured people unless necessary. Apply direct pressure to stop heavy bleeding. Wait for emergency responders.

questions.question: Always signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area.

questions.explanation: Use your turn signal when changing lanes, entering or leaving a parking space, or pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: Highway markings:

options.text: Are only found in construction zones.
Are usually red and blue in color.

questions.explanation: Highway markings give drivers information. They show where to position your vehicle, identify safe passing zones, and warn about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: Defensive driving is:

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid crashes.
Getting ahead of bad drivers by speeding through traffic.
Following the car ahead of you very closely.
Quickly changing lanes and weaving through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid crashes.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you spot dangerous situations before they become accidents and take action. It helps you avoid crashes caused by reckless, careless, or intoxicated drivers.

questions.question: An "End school zone" sign means:

options.text: That the speed limit is 20 mph.
The beginning of a reduced speed zone.
The increased possibility of encountering pedestrians.
The end of a reduced speed zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The end of a reduced speed zone.
questions.explanation: Do not exceed the school zone speed limit during the times shown. The "End school zone" sign marks where the reduced speed zone ends.

questions.question: When should you not pass?

options.text: When school bus lights are flashing.

questions.explanation: Never pass if you cannot see ahead clearly due to a hill or curve, at an intersection, before or on a railroad crossing or bridge, or in any no passing zone. Never pass a school bus with flashing red lights unless you are on the opposite side of a multilane road with a median or shared center turn lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: How can you prevent hydroplaning?

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread depth.
Make sure your tires are properly inflated.
Slow down when driving in the rain.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, check that your tires have good tread and are inflated to the correct pressure. Slow down when it rains because hydroplaning happens more often at higher speeds.

questions.question: Before entering a roundabout, you must slow down and yield to:
questions.explanation: When entering a roundabout, you must yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles already in the roundabout.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spot before changing lanes?

options.text: Look in the left side mirror.
Look in the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot before changing lanes, look over your shoulder toward the direction you plan to move.

questions.question: The 'No zone' is:

options.text: A term for blind spots around trucks or buses.
A roadway with limits on stereo volume.
A television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: A term for blind spots around trucks or buses.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on each side, behind, and in front. Cars cannot be seen in these areas. These spots are called the 'No zone.'

questions.question: When turning, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when turning so you can control your vehicle, stay in your lane, and react to unexpected situations.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to a driver?
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your brain and reduces the skills you need for safe driving. It slows your reaction time and impairs your judgment.

questions.question: When turning left, drivers must yield to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic. Always yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.
